facts.claim: J. B. Vieira is a wholesale and retail dealer in beef, mutton, lamb, pork, veal, and various sausages on Main Street in Bodie.
facts.quote: Wholesale and Retail Dealer in Beef, Mutton, Lamb, Pork, Veal, and Sausage of all kinds, Prices to suit the times, Patrons will receive polite and prompt attention.
